name: ENAV S.p.A.
notes: enav.it describes ENAV as the manager of Italian airspace (air traffic control, air navigation services); legal name ENAV S.p.A. (Via Salaria 716, Rome) per the site footer. Logos are website-served (tier 2): the colour SVG is the header logo on enav.it; the white PNG is the footer logo, served from the publisher's website CDN host cdn-web.enav.it and referenced directly by the enav.it page (hence cdn-web.enav.it in official_domains, page_url on enav.it). The Media kit page (enav.it/en/media/media-kit) offers 'ENAV GROUP LOGOS' only as a secure download for which the password must be requested from ENAV; it was not accessed. No logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.

gaps.reason: ENAV's media kit logos are password-protected ('contact us to request the password'); not accessed, left for manual request

contact.notes: Media kit page states the logo pack password must be requested from ENAV; no address read on that page.
